name: IRONFLESH GALA — Chrome & Geneware Haute Couture Summit
creator: Axiom Aesthetics Division / Sable-Voss Design House
description: The most prestigious augmentation fashion event in GLMZ, held annually in the Spire's Atrium Cascades and broadcast via curated neural feed to Tier 4-5 subscribers. Designers present integrated chrome-and-geneware ensembles where augmentation and biological modification are treated as a unified couture language — runway models display living bioluminescent skin grafts alongside surgical-grade titanium lacework. The event draws the wealthiest clients, corponation executives, and licensed augmentation surgeons as both audience and participants.
medium: neural feed (Tier 4-5 subscription), physical attendance (Spire), holographic rebroadcast
cultural_impact: IRONFLESH defines the aesthetic aspirations of Meridian's elite augmentation culture, setting trends that trickle down through the tiers in cheaper, often dangerous imitation forms in the Gray Zone.
controversy: Repeatedly condemned by the Sovereign Body movement for presenting radical bodily modification as luxury consumption; a 2214 protest saw thirty demonstrators surgically stitch their mouths shut on the Atrium steps before security removal.
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone-born geneware artist receives a forged invitation to IRONFLESH and must navigate Spire security, class hostility, and their own ambivalence about whether winning legitimacy inside this system means anything.
A Sable-Voss model discovers mid-runway that a geneware modification applied for the show is irreversible — and the designer knew.
Someone leaks IRONFLESH's private client augmentation records to a the Gray Zone pirate feed, revealing which Tier 5 executives have illegal military-grade chrome hidden under cosmetic coverings.
